Here's a tip on fishing for stocked trout, or probably any stocked fish, They were raised on brown pellets that fell from the sky, they didn't learn hunting instincts out of the egg. So once they are released into a pond or lake or whatever, they don't eat for a while and expect food to fall from the sky, or learn to eat what the bigger older fish eat. Up here bugs fall from the sky, so that's usually what the fish go for.
